items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: And he would open the door and Elvis then could peer in and watch him play the piano.

ctx.x: And Ike used to leave, it was in the black section of town, because he was always going down to the black section of town without telling mama. He goes, boy there was an alley in this place where Ike was playing in the afternoon matinees. And he would open the door and Elvis then could peer in and watch him play the piano. And he says, “Oh we knew Elvis was a hip little cat, man, at that time, he just loved our music, he loved our music.” And so he knew about white Gospel, black Gospel. He knew about the great…
What do you think about Colonel Tom Parker?
